ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Scams in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of Medicaid scams in Minnesota and look for any patterns or connections to other entities or programs.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid scams in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent similar scams in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger pattern of fraud and corruption in Minnesota, and could lead to increased oversight and monitoring of Medicaid claims.
